_comment: Per-release values a person writes; the renderer reads the rest from the release directory. Update every key for each release, from the release evidence (vulnerabilities.md, gitleaks.json, semgrep.sarif, bun-audit.txt) and the full-gate run. VERSION must equal release/manifest.json.
